title: Quantifying True Robustness: Synonymity-Weighted Similarity for Trustworthy XAI Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of robustness metrics for Explainable AI (XAI) using synonymity weighting. While it mentions trust and utilizes a gender bias dataset as a test case, its primary focus is on mathematical similarity measures rather than evaluating religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
